Since August 17, 2018, it had 0 insider buys, and 1 sale for $363,405 activity. Southwest Airlines (NYSE:LUV) Rating Reaffirmed
Southwest Airlines (NYSE:LUV) just had their share rating of a ‘Overweight’ issued by research analysts at Morgan Stanley, who now has a $64 target price on the $29.51B market cap company or a 21.95 % upside potential. This key information was shown in a report on Wednesday, 14 November. Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE:LUV) Ratings Coverage
Among 13 analysts covering Southwest Airlines ( NYSE:LUV ), 9 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 69% are positive. Southwest Airlines has $73 highest and $52 lowest target. $64.09’s average target is 22.12% above currents $52.48 stock price. (NYSE:LUV) has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, October 26 by Raymond James. Buckingham Research maintained it with “Buy” rating and $69 target in Friday, July 27 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank on Monday, June 11. The company was maintained on Wednesday, June 13 by Buckingham Research. The rating was maintained by Buckingham Research on Friday, September 7 with “Buy”. JP Morgan downgraded Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE:LUV) on Tuesday, October 30 to “Underweight” rating. Imperial Capital maintained the shares of LUV in report on Thursday, September 27 with “In-Line” rating.
The stock decreased 0.47% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $52.48. About 4.35 million shares traded. Southwest Airlines Co. (NYSE:LUV) has risen 13.75% since November 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.87% the S&P500.
Southwest Airlines Co. operates a passenger airline that provides scheduled air transportation services in the United States and near-international markets. The company has market cap of $29.51 billion. As of December 31, 2016, the firm operated a total of 723 Boeing 737 aircraft; and served 101 destinations in 40 states, the District of Columbia, and the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, as well as 8 near-international countries, including Mexico, Jamaica, The Bahamas, Aruba, the Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Belize, and Cuba. It has a 8.58 P/E ratio. It also sells frequent flyer points and related services to business partners participating in the Rapid Rewards frequent flyer program, such as car rental agencies, hotels, restaurants, and retailers.
